name: yashpatel-py
description: Unofficial skills and guardrails for Robinhood Agentic Trading (MCP). Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Inc.

plugins.name: robinhood-trading
plugins.description: Unofficial. Six skills for Robinhood's agentic-trading MCP: checked order tickets, cross-account wash-sale checks, exit protection with native alerts, an options monitor (exits, expiration, assignment), an agent report card and a config-driven options screener. Simulates orders by default; a fail-closed PreToolUse hook blocks placement, and opt-in confirm mode asks you to approve each reviewed order.

plugins.name: unofficial-rh-connector
plugins.description: Unofficial helper that adds Robinhood's official Trading MCP endpoint (OAuth in a desktop browser). Install it instead of claude mcp add, never as well: two server entries expose the same tools twice. This repo's evals don't use it; leave it off any machine that runs them.
